name: Arya Vaidya Sala
locations: 27 branch clinics across India per the official site
summary: Arya Vaidya Sala, Kottakkal is an Ayurveda institution founded by Vaidyaratnam P. S. Varier, running Ayurvedic hospitals and research centres, a charitable hospital, medicine manufacturing units and an Ayurveda college. It offers consultations, in-patient and walk-in Ayurvedic treatments from its Kottakkal campus.
highlights: Founded in 1902 in Kottakkal by Vaidyaratnam P. S. Varier
Ayurvedic Hospital and Research Centres at Kottakkal, Kochi and Delhi, plus a Charitable Hospital at Kottakkal
Kottakkal Ayurvedic Hospital and Research Centre holds NABH accreditation (2016, per the official site)
Vaidyaratnam P.S. Varier Ayurveda College and Centre for Medicinal Plants Research
Three medicine manufacturing units producing over 550 formulations
